g.text: OM2W · 300 attempted per cell; success = successes / valid outcomes. Valid subsets differ. Historical 100 included; collection windows differ.
Valid success denominators (Sol / Luna / N3 / N5): BrowserCode 266 / 269 / 269 / 267; native 286 / 271 / 270 / 270.
X-axis means include measured invalid attempts. Latency coverage (Sol / Luna / N3 / N5): BrowserCode 275 / 274 / 275 / 273; native 300 / 300 / 300 / 298. Missing values are not zero-filled.
Command coverage: BrowserCode 300 / 300 / 293 / 294; native 300 / 300 / 300 / 298. One execution can contain multiple actions.
Cost coverage 300 each: BrowserCode original receipts (N3 has one unknown-usage call); native includes helpers/full reserves. External judging excluded.
Native 20,000 tokens / 100 decisions; BrowserCode 12,288 / 30. Timing and execution granularity differ; descriptive comparison. Tables separate.
